{{Short description|German-Austrian political scientist and economist (1843–1908)}}
{{Expand German|topic=bio|Theodor Inama von Sternegg|date=March 2025}}

'''Karl Theodor Ferdinand Michael Inama von Sternegg''' (20 January 1843, in [[Augsburg]] – 28 November 1908, in [[Innsbruck]]) was a German-born Austrian political scientist, statistician, and economist, who served as the second president of the [[International Statistical Institute]] from 1899 to 1908, and was a member of the [[Imperial Council (Austria)|Austrian Imperial Council]], the [[Austrian Academy of Sciences]], the [[Accademia dei Lincei]], the [[Prussian Academy of Sciences]], the [[Bavarian Academy of Sciences and Humanities]], and the [[German National Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]]. He was the father of painter [[Fanny Inama von Sternegg]].<ref>{{cite book |last1=von Wurzbach |first1=Constant |author1-link=Constant von Wurzbach |title=[[Biographisches Lexikon des Kaiserthums Oesterreich]] |date=1879 |publisher=Kaiserlich-königliche Hof- und Staatsdruckerei |location=Vienna |pages=304–306 |language=de |chapter=Inama-Sternegg, Karl Theodor Ferdinand Michael von}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last1=Matis |first1=Herbert |title=[[Neue Deutsche Biographie]] |date=1974 |publisher=Duncker & Humblot |location=Berlin |isbn=3-428-00191-5 |pages=166–168 |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |title=[[Österreichisches Biographisches Lexikon 1815–1950]] |date=1965 |publisher=Austrian Academy of Sciences |location=Vienna |isbn=3-7001-1329-3 |pages=32f, 32–33 |volume=3 |language=de |chapter=Inama von Sternegg, Fanny}}</ref>
